description: This file defines the KpiService class within the OrangeHRM Performance module. It provides methods for managing KPI entities, including saving KPIs with transaction management, and references external Data Access Object (KpiDao) and entity classes.

classes.name: KpiService
classes.description: Service class providing KPI management functionalities, including saving KPIs with transaction handling and validation.

methods.name: getKpiDao
methods.description: Lazy initializes and returns the KpiDao instance for database operations related to KPIs.

methods.name: saveKpi
methods.description: Validates and saves a KPI entity, managing database transactions and handling exceptions.
